entries.name: Key West Cocktail Cruise
entries.reason: two pks return an identical breakdown, and the tiers are beverage packages rather than customer types
evidence_for: both live: v1 200, not archived, not private, not unlisted
both bookable on all 18 dates sampled (14 consecutive + 30/60/90/120)
it is a genuine public boat cruise — the only per-person party-shaped boat left uncarded in Key West
evidence_against: 487934 and 487926 return BYTE-IDENTICAL breakdowns: $80 'Craft Cocktails, Craft Beer & Wine Option', $65 'Craft Beer & Wine Option', $55 'Non-Alcoholic Beverage Option'
those are BEVERAGE PACKAGES, not customer types — so 'entry tier' is meaningless here; the $55 is a non-alcoholic option, not a cheaper seat
no duration is derivable from any tier name
carding either pk without resolving which is canonical risks publishing the same product twice
entries.blocker: Decide (a) which pk is canonical, (b) whether the product is per-person at all, and (c) the trip length. Not resolvable from the price-preview breakdown — the tiers describe what you drink, not who you are.
entries.if_resolved: card the canonical pk at $80 with the package named explicitly in the copy, and soft-delete or alias the duplicate
